summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ZOZO Burger application focusing on NEW features: Featured Products Carousel, Reviews Section, Order-Type-Selection Modal, Product Customizer with Icons, Lazy Loading, Order Tracking, Admin Featured Products, and Responsive Design. Backend: 100% success (18/18 tests). Frontend: 75% success with critical authentication bug in admin panel.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening status badges not displaying on location cards
ui_bugs.details: Location cards found but opening_status badges (Geöffnet/Geschlossen) are not rendering despite backend returning opening_status data

integration_issues.issue: Modal backdrop blocks clicks on underlying elements
integration_issues.details: When Order-Type-Selection Modal is open, the backdrop intercepts pointer events preventing clicks on 'Hier bestellen' buttons. Users cannot proceed with order flow.
integration_issues.workaround: Users can navigate directly to /menu page or use 'Speisekarte ansehen' button

integration_issues.issue: Admin token not persisting after login - 401 errors on all admin endpoints
integration_issues.details: Admin login succeeds (200 OK) but subsequent API calls to /api/admin/menu-items and /api/admin/orders return 401 Unauthorized. Token is not being stored in localStorage or not being sent in Authorization header.
integration_issues.impact: Admin panel completely non-functional - cannot manage featured products, orders, or menu items
